CommunicationPreferenceMarketingPermissi.description: One communication preference category, as the privacy administrator defines it (pack 17.1.4 Configuration).

classification.description: The pack's critical principle. Decides whether consent is needed at all.

consentPurpose.description: Required for `marketing`. The purpose whose consent a send checks first.

applicableBrandIds.description: Empty means every brand of the tenant.

customerEditable.description: Whether the guest may change it in the preference centre.

reconfirmAfterMonths.description: Ask the guest again after this long; null never.

ConsentCapturePointCustomerJourneyConfig.description: One capture point's journey configuration (pack 17.1.7 Journey Configuration).

policyKind.description: For a notice or terms step, the white-label policy kind shown (its current published version is shown; the guest's acceptance records that version).

wording.description: Consent wording shown at this step, per language.

mandatory.description: A mandatory step blocks the journey until answered; a marketing consent is never mandatory.

ConsentCapturePointCustomerJourneyConfig.description: A stored capture point and its journey, at its current version.

noticeVersion.description: Current version of the notice. A consent against a superseded version is reported as requiring renewal rather than silently honoured.

isRequiredForService.description: True for transactional. Withdrawing it means the service cannot be delivered, so it is presented differently.

ConsentSource.description: `checkout` (30 September, M18-15): an opt-in ticked beside the terms at checkout, carried on orders `checkoutCart` `marketingConsents[]` and recorded by `recordCheckoutConsents`, bound to the order and the verified contact. `cookieBanner` (29 September, build; BL-073 §4b): a decision made on the cookie banner or preference centre and moved onto the guest by `claimDeviceConsent`. Kept apart from `website`, a form submission, because the audit trail (2.6.56) has to tell the two apart.

CookieBannerPreferenceCenterDesignerView.description: One version of a cookie banner and preference-centre design (pack 17.1.6).

brandId.description: Null for the corporate design every brand inherits.

themeId.description: The white-label theme it takes colours and fonts from.

defaultOn.description: True only for `strictlyNecessary`, which is always active.

languages.description: Every language the storefront serves; Arabic renders right to left.

regulatoryRegimes.description: 2.6.60 (29 September, build). **The laws this design is published to satisfy**, so compliance is stated rather than assumed. The strictest posture (opt-in, one-click reject, every non-essential category off) already meets GDPR/ePrivacy, LGPD and both PDPLs; `ccpaCpra` adds the "Do not sell or share" button (`doNotSellOrShare`) and honours a Global Privacy Control signal as that opt-out.

recordIpAddress.description: 2.6.55, "if legally permitted" (29 September, build). On, `recordDeviceConsent` writes the IP address and user agent to `pii.consent_identifier`; off, they are not kept anywhere. Off by default.

noticeVersion.description: Moves with the cookie policy (white-label `setPolicy`, kind `cookie`).

CookieCategory.description: 2.6.53. The five categories the banner design (`CookieBannerPreferenceCenterDesignerView.categories`) offers; the matrix's "preference" category is `personalisation` (British spelling, as `ConsentPurpose`).

CookieConsentChannel.description: The six governed surfaces, as the registry and the banner design name them (pack 17.1.5-17.1.6).

CookieScanFinding.description: **One technology one scan saw, in one consent state** (Chinmay, 2 October, contract follow-ups; CHG-FUP-009). Written by `recordCookieScan` from `findings[]`, never edited; read by `listCookieScanFindings`. Kept with its run, so an audit can show what loaded before consent on a given day.

technologyId.description: The registry entry the finding matched or created (`name` + `provider` + `domainApplication`).

isPreConsentViolation.description: Seen with no decision or after reject-all, and its category (the registry's, else the suggested one) is not `strictlyNecessary`. An unclassified technology counts as a violation, as `detected` is treated as blocked.

CookieScanPolicy.description: How often one channel's domain or app is scanned and who is alerted (2.6.64).

scanSource.description: **Who scans this channel** (Chinmay, 2 October: buy a scanner API, hybrid; CHG-CSA-023). `boughtScanner`: the scheduled run calls the bought scanner API through TICVAI's adapter, which feeds `recordCookieScan`. `manualUpload`: no scheduled scan; an administrator uploads a scan report.

scannerVendorRef.description: The scanner vendor and the account or domain group the adapter uses; set by TICVAI when the vendor is contracted.

newlyDetectedCount.description: What the administrator alert is raised from.

missingCount.description: Registry entries for this channel the scan did not see.

preConsentViolationCount.description: Findings seen with no decision or after reject-all whose category is not `strictlyNecessary` (CHG-FUP-009). Above zero, the administrator alert is raised.

CookieTrackingDigitalTechnologyRegistryV.description: One governed tracking technology (pack 17.1.5 Registry Fields; BL-073 §4a).

name.description: The cookie, SDK, pixel or storage key as it appears on the device.

domainApplication.description: The domain, or the app and version, it was found on.

category.description: Null until an administrator classifies it.

privacyInformation.description: What the preference centre tells the guest about it.

DataProcessingPurposeLawfulBasisRegistry.description: One processing purpose in the tenant's register (pack 17.1.2). The lawful basis is the privacy administrator's classification, never the platform's.

dataControllerApplicableOrganization.description: The legal entity acting as controller for this purpose.

dataCategories.description: e.g. contact details, payment, date of birth, images.

lawfulBasis.description: Set by the privacy administrator. `unclassified` is flagged, never assumed.

consentPurposes.description: The consent purposes that rely on this processing purpose.

policyIds.description: Notices and policies that describe it (white-label `listPolicies`).

MinorGuardianAgeBasedPrivacyConfiguratio.description: One jurisdiction's age and guardian rule (pack 17.1.9 Age Rules, Guardian Verification).

country.description: The jurisdiction the rule applies to.

minorBelowAge.description: A guest younger than this is a minor. Set by the tenant; no default.

guardianRequiredBelowAge.description: A guardian must give privacy consent for a guest younger than this. Not above `minorBelowAge`.

guardianDataRequired.description: What is captured about the guardian.

restrictMarketing.description: No marketing to a minor, whatever consent is given.

restrictedProcessingPurposeCodes.description: Further processing purposes refused for minors (e.g. biometrics without guardian consent).

PrivacyConfigurationTestingApprovalPubli.description: One action on a privacy change set (pack 17.1.10).

changeSetId.description: Null on the first action, which opens a change set.

items.description: The draft versions in the change set. Required when the set is opened.

target.description: For `publish`; an empty list means all.

PrivacyConfigurationTestingApprovalPubli.description: A privacy change set, its validation, approval, publication and audit trail.

simulation.description: What the scenario's guest would be shown, step by step (from `simulate`; not stored).

PrivacyConsentConfigurationCommandCenter.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over marketing.consent_purpose, marketing.consent_capture_point (new), marketing.communication_preference_type (new), the cookie categories and white-label's whitelabel.policy (read through listPolicies)
PrivacyConsentConfigurationCommandCenter.description: The privacy command centre's figures for the filters given, and the latest configuration changes. Counts are of items currently in force unless the name says otherwise.

scheduledPolicyChanges.description: Published items with an `effectiveFrom` still in the future.

consentConfigurationsRequiringReview.description: Items in `review`, or whose reconfirmation interval has passed.

configurationWarnings.description: Configuration checks that failed, most severe first.

configurationDirectory.description: The 50 most recently changed configuration items, newest `effectiveFrom` first.

scope.description: Where it applies, as the scope path's label (a brand, country or channel).

PrivacyNoticeGovernance.description: **The privacy governance of one version of one privacy document.** The document itself is white-label's `Policy` (`setPolicy`, never overwritten); this row adds what the privacy administrator decides about it: lifecycle status, the change classification (set by an authorised user, **never by AI**), re-acceptance and notification, owner and approval. One row per policy version. Read by `listPrivacyNoticePolicy`; written by `setPrivacyNoticePolicyGovernance` (decided 29 September, writers pass). (decided 29 September, data model for the agreed operations)

policyId.description: The white-label `Policy` version this governs (`documentId` on the view).

changeClassification.description: Set by an authorised user, never by AI.

approvalRequestId.description: The approvals request raised when the row entered `review` (`setPrivacyNoticePolicyGovernance`); its decision stamps `approvedByPrincipalId` and `approvedAt`. (decided 29 September, writers pass)

PrivacyNoticePolicyTermsVersionManagemen.x-ticvai-persistence: none — projection over whitelabel.policy (read through white-label listPolicies), marketing.privacy_notice_governance and marketing.consent_record
PrivacyNoticePolicyTermsVersionManagemen.description: One version of one privacy document, with its governance (pack 17.1.8 Version Information).

changeClassification.description: Set by an authorised user, never by AI.

requiresReAcceptance.description: Guests are asked to accept this version at their next capture point.

requiresNotification.description: Guests are told of the change by a transactional message.

acceptedCount.description: Guests whose recorded acceptance is of this version.

domainApplication.description: The domain, or the app and version, scanned.

scannerRef.description: The vendor and scan id where the scanner is bought; null for ours or a manual upload.

consentState.description: The consent state the page was loaded in when the technology was seen (CHG-FUP-009). Absent from a scanner that tests one state only; such a finding proves nothing about consent.

pageUrl.description: The page the technology was seen on.

initiatorUrl.description: The script or frame that set it, so a violation names its cause (a tag manager, an embed).

suggestedCategory.description: The category the scanner or the catalogue suggests. A suggestion only; the venue's administrator classifies it with `setTrackingTechnology`.

TrackingTechnologyCatalogueEntry.description: **The platform's catalogue of known cookies and trackers** (Chinmay, 2 October, contract follow-ups: "a platform-wide catalogue of known cookies"; CHG-FUP-010). One row per known technology, matched on `namePattern` + `provider`, with the category TICVAI's privacy owner approved. Seeded from the Open Cookie Database (Apache-2.0) and curated by platform staff; mastered in the control plane and replicated read-only into every cell with the platform root as `scopePath`, as the platform model catalogue is. **It suggests, it does not decide**: a scan finding that matches takes `suggestedCategory` from it with `classificationSource` `platformCatalogue`, and each venue still approves its own registry entry (`setTrackingTechnology`), so `_ga` is suggested once for every tenant rather than researched by each.

entryKey.description: The stable key the entry is written under (`setTrackingTechnologyCatalogueEntry`), such as `google-analytics-ga`; taken from the path.

namePattern.description: The cookie or key name, with `*` as a wildcard (`_ga_*`).

source.description: Imported, or added or corrected by platform staff.

isActive.description: A retired entry stops suggesting; it is kept for the findings that cited it.

scopePath.description: **The partition key** (ADR-0005): the platform root on every replicated row.
